text: Eyal Bab You can read about it on Step 2 of our website here. In our experience of having worked with hundreds of cases, it is very rare for PIBA to ask for a Hebrew translation of a certificate that was originally in English, and if they do they will always let you know and give you more time to provide it. I would recommend saving yourself the money in the first instance. https://aic.org.il/partner-visa-in-israel-step-by-step-guide-to-your-first-visa/
